#RedHat  and its parent company #ibm have been among the most vocal advocates for an open ecosystem to mitigate the new risks emerging in the #agenticAI era. In the past three months, the two companies have been part of multiple efforts to shore up #OSSsecurity and supply chains. 

However, in many ways, the longstanding issues in the industry with open source sustainability and #cybersecurity diligence are bigger than even multiple large IT vendors. Will the scope and scale of agentic #AI security risks finally be what forces systemic change?

This week on IT Ops Query, Brian Gracely, senior director of portfolio strategy at Red Hat, and I discuss: 

 💡 The state of industry debate about open-weight models

 💡 Agentic AI's effect on open source's "tragedy of the commons"

 💡 Lightwell's approach to #OSS  security

 💡 What enterprise IT leaders should know about open source sustainability and security going forward

And more!

Check it out here: https://youtu.be/iLsOzdVqQVA?si=KDyU1TJdlYDrU-yp
